governing_claim: Stage F autonomous-reference execution measures the generating model's semantic annotations and Stage D outcomes relative to a blinded, independently generated autonomous reviewer consensus. Autonomous consensus annotations are not human reference labels, human ground truth, or evidence of human semantic reliability.
human_pilot_statement: Stage F-AR does not execute, constitute, substitute for, or satisfy the Stage F human-reference pilot. The term pilot remains reserved for the locked human-reference track. O-3 remains PRE_RUN_REQUIRED and human pilot_ready remains false.

ar_batches.AR_44_INITIAL_AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION_BATCH: AR-44 INITIAL AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION BATCH: the locked 44-slot material (22 Arm G scenarios x 2, run order E3F_RUN_ORDER_V1) used by Stage F-AR; operational only; never used for any AR decision rule
ar_batches.AR_FULL_RUN: the 220 Arm G proposals and 240 Arm A annotation runs, used by Stage F-AR

locked_harness_run_kind_mapping: The locked harness binds generator runs with its own run-kind enum, which cannot be renamed; its identifier for the 44-slot material maps to AR_44_INITIAL_AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTION_BATCH and never describes a Stage F-AR run.

panel_rules.adjudicator_output: complete explicit annotation, not a choice of Review X or Review Y

contains: Review X: anonymized parsed annotation payload
Review Y: anonymized parsed annotation payload
(packet segment id, item) pairs on which Review X and Review Y disagree
never_exposes: which review originated from Reviewer A or Reviewer B
adjudicator_visible_request.x_y_order_rule: Review X and Review Y are ordered by the SHA-256 of each payload's canonical content, independent of reviewer role
adjudicator_visible_request.bound_outside_visible_request: exact Reviewer A and Reviewer B record hashes and full reviewer provenance (request metadata and the adjudicator record)

consensus_logic: Reviewer A and Reviewer B annotate independently; both records are written before comparison
exact agreement on status, reviewer adjudication flag, all eleven fields (both SCORABLE), and both flags -> AUTONOMOUS_CONSENSUS_REFERENCE; adjudicator not invoked
any governed disagreement -> Autonomous Adjudicator invoked with both recorded annotations as anonymized Review X and Review Y; A and B record hashes bound outside the visible request
adjudicator produces a complete annotation; result AUTONOMOUS_ADJUDICATED_REFERENCE
raw and parsed A and B outputs, adjudicator output, final reference, disagreements, and all hashes preserved

autonomous_blocker_descriptions.AR-PRE-2: autonomous reviewer prompt, output schema, and retry / malformed-output policy freeze
autonomous_blocker_descriptions.AR-PRE-3: reviewer-family correlation assessment, owner-reviewed, bound to the exact panel
autonomous_blocker_descriptions.AR-PRE-4: qualification diagnostic and its frozen decision rules: qualification governance frozen first, then qualification on the frozen calibration corpus, bound to the exact panel, every attempt preserved
autonomous_blocker_descriptions.AR-PRE-5: autonomous run-order freeze, bound to the exact panel
autonomous_blocker_descriptions.AR-PRE-6: explicit owner authorization to execute Stage F-AR

decision_rule_thresholds: none frozen; AR-C reports every item without a cut-off
permitted_claims: The generator agreed with the blinded autonomous consensus on X% of scorable field judgments.
Y Stage D outcomes differed when the generator's annotations were replaced with the autonomous adjudicated annotation.
Reviewer A and Reviewer B disagreed on Z% of scorable field judgments.
The Autonomous Adjudicator was invoked for W of N reviewed packets.
prohibited_claims: The model was X% accurate relative to humans.
The autonomous reference is ground truth.
The system achieved human-level semantic reliability.
Zero autonomous false passes proves safety.
calibration_use: reviewer qualification diagnostic only; not an evaluation result, not a continuously reusable tuning set, not human ground truth; answer key never given to reviewers

must_freeze_before_qualification: what constitutes semantic disagreement for qualification
whether qualification can disqualify a configuration
qualification_governance.no_iterative_tuning: No reviewer prompt, model, or configuration may be iteratively tuned against calibration results and then treated as the same setup.
qualification_governance.configuration_version_identity: configuration_sha256; qualification binds the exact panel hash
qualification_governance.prior_attempts: every prior qualification attempt preserved and named by hash

o3_exposure.statement: All Stage F-AR annotations, disagreements, adjudications and comparison results are labelled evaluation-derived material for O-3 exposure purposes.
o3_exposure.prospective_candidates: Prospective future human Primary A, Primary B, or Adjudicator candidates must not be shown Stage F-AR labelled outputs before their eligibility is determined.

governance.note: No O-5-bound, harness-bound, design, calibration, or human-protocol file is modified; Stage F-AR files sit outside every locked coverage glob. No amendment or rebinding was needed.

claim_boundary_summary: Offline design and code only, tested with handwritten synthetic records. Nothing executed. Results, once produced, are relative to a blinded autonomous reviewer consensus only; not human reference labels, ground truth, human semantic reliability, safety, semantic validation, purchase prediction, sales lift, production security, or evidence for BAEC theory.

test_result.note: Software tests over handwritten synthetic records. Not evidence about any model, annotator, or BAEC theory.
